roles.label: ⭐ Partner (the boss this week)
roles.what: You run the pretend company. You set it up on day 1, switch your team on, say yes or no to money going out (the second person), approve customer notices, and decide about the new area.
screens: Me → ⚙️ Admin: People · Areas · Company & hubs · Price list · Who sees what · Custom fields · Settings
routine: 09:00 Open Home. Read Needs attention first.
Clear 👥 Approvals before 10:00 and again before 12:00 — nobody's money waits for you.
Answer any 📡 outage notice within 15 minutes.
11:45 Read the day's Friday report (Money → 📊 Report) and post one line in the team group: what went well, what went wrong.

focus.how: Do the numbers on Home and 🏢 HQ match what your team really did today? Are names and areas right in Live activity? Try 📣 a message to one person from HQ: did it open WhatsApp with the right number and words?

roles.label: 💰 Finance (the money desk)
roles.what: You keep the money straight: cash counts, money in and out, bills, staff pay, billing-website files, and the reports.
screens: Money → ✍️ Record (Money out · Money in · 🧾 Snap a receipt)
Money → 📋 Bills (Bills · Pay run · 👥 Approvals · Staff & pay)
Money → 🏦 Statements → 📥 Bring in a file (billing-website files)
routine: 08:45 Count the cash for both areas (Money → Count the cash).
Check 👥 Approvals: confirm the techs' receipts.
Record every payment the same hour it happens — never at the end of the day.
11:30 Money → 📊 Report: read it. Anything red → tell the Partner.

focus.t: Every amount, total and M-Pesa code
focus.how: Amounts and dates right everywhere? M-Pesa codes are 10 letters and numbers (like UJK4W8NB2Q). Do Cash today, Bills and the Pay run add up? Are VAT and supplier PINs right on receipts?

roles.label: 📞 Call center 1 (Town Centre desk)
roles.what: You answer the Town Centre customers: new sign-ups, problems, questions. You make the jobs and send a technician.
screens: Jobs (＋ New job · All techs · 📩 Today's texts)
routine: 09:00 Open Jobs → 📩 Today's texts: work every card.
Every call becomes something in Zuri: a customer, a job, a note or a task. Nothing stays only in your head.
Before you make a new customer, SEARCH first (name or phone) — no doubles.
11:50 Jobs → All techs: is any job without a tech or a day? Fix it.

focus.how: Names spelled right? Phone numbers in 07xx xxx xxx form (or +254…)? Directions clear enough for a tech to find the house? Try every 📞 Call, 💬 WhatsApp and 📩 Text button: does it open the right person with the right words?

roles.label: 📞 Call center 2 (Satellite desk + payment calls)
roles.what: You answer the Satellite customers and you make the payment calls. In an outage you tell callers what is happening.
screens: Jobs (📩 Today's texts · Payment follow-ups · outage banner)
routine: 09:00 Jobs → 📩 Today's texts.
If a red 📡 Possible outage box shows, read it to every caller from that area. No new visit needed.
A customer says “I paid”? Ask for the M-Pesa code, write it in a note, and make a task for Finance.
11:50 Tasks → My day: tick what you finished.

focus.how: Do the 💬 WhatsApp and 📩 Text buttons open with the right number and the right words? Do promised dates come back on the right day? Is “Paid until” right for each customer?

roles.label: 🛠️ Field tech 1 (Town Centre — installs)
roles.what: You connect new homes in Town Centre and fix what breaks. Your phone is your office: jobs, pins, photos, parts, money collected, receipts.
screens: Jobs → My jobs (To do · Done · 📍 Nearest first)
A job: ▶ I'm starting now · 📍 pin · 📷 photo · parts · ✅ Job finished
🧾 Snap a receipt · Me → 🧾 My receipts
routine: 08:50 Open My jobs. Tap 📍 Nearest first.
At every house: ▶ I'm starting now → pin → work → parts with serial → photo → what you found / did (tap at least one “What did you do?”) → money collected → ✅ Job finished.
Spent Zuri money? Snap the receipt the same minute.
Before you stop: My jobs → To do should be empty or have a note on each job.

focus.how: At every install drop the 📍 pin, then check on the 🗺️ Map that it is on the right house. Every router/ONT has its serial number. Photos attach and show on the job.

roles.label: 🛠️ Field tech 2 (Town Centre — faults & businesses)
roles.what: You fix faults in Town Centre and look after the business customers (salon, hotel).
routine: 08:50 Open My jobs, nearest first.
Business customers first when they are urgent.
Collected money? Type the M-Pesa code every time.
Snap every receipt.

focus.how: Is what you found and what you did saved right? Parts with serial numbers? Photos show? Does 🗺️ Open map take you to the right place?

roles.label: 🛠️ Field tech 3 (Satellite)
roles.what: You cover Satellite: installs, faults, and the Satellite cabinet. On day 4 you find the cable cut.
routine: 08:50 Open My jobs.
If many Satellite customers are down, check the cabinet FIRST — tell the Partner what you find.
Snap every receipt.
Pins: stand outside the house, then 📍.

focus.how: Is the area right on every job? Try a job with no signal (airplane mode), then turn signal back on: does everything send? Pins and photos too.

roles.label: 🎭 Customer voice (you play the customers)
roles.what: You are every customer. At the time on your script you phone (a normal phone call, or WhatsApp — whichever they use) the call-center person named, say your lines, and check what they do. You are our toughest customer — but a fair one.
screens: Your script on the Testers' List (Business Week)
routine: Call at the time on the script (± 5 min).
Say who you are and your pretend phone number. Spell names if asked.
At the end of each call write what happened on your list: ✅ if they did it right, ❌ if not (say what).
Never give real numbers or real names of real people.

focus.how: When Zuri sends you a WhatsApp or text, is your name right, the amount right, the words clear? Take a screenshot of every message you receive and tell us if anything is wrong.

customers: Behind the Total petrol station, green gate
Near the matatu stage, blue door
Old Naivasha road, after the bridge
Kamuyu road, after the posho mill
Off the Suswa road, mabati house
Green house near the water tank

days.title: Open the doors
days.story: A brand-new, EMPTY company. No areas, no customers, no money yet. The Partner builds it at 09:00; by 12:00 we have two areas, a price list, a team switched on, staff and bills, opening cash, and our first four customers booked for installs.

ch.t: Sign in and make the company
ch.do: Open the training copy and sign in. Me → ⚙️ Admin → Company & hubs. Company name: Zuri Fiber (Business Week). Town: Maai Mahiu. Office phone 0700 000 800. M-Pesa Paybill 600100. KRA PIN P051234567X. Tap Save the company.
ch.end: “Company saved.” and the name shows when you open the page again.

ch.do: Admin → Areas. Add: code TC, name Town Centre, M-Pesa float target 30000 → Add area. Then code SA, name Satellite, float target 15000 → Add area.
ch.end: Two rows: TC Town Centre (30,000) and SA Satellite (15,000). The area picker at the top shows both (if not, pull down to refresh).

ch.do: Admin → People. For each tester: pick the job and area, tick On, Save. Finance = Office staff + Finance. Call center 1 = Call center, Town Centre. Call center 2 = Call center, Satellite. Tech 1 and Tech 2 = Field tech, Town Centre. Tech 3 = Field tech, Satellite.
ch.end: No “waiting to be switched on” line. Six people switched on with the right job. Tell the team group: “You are on.”

ch.t: Sign in (after the Partner switches you on)
ch.do: Open the training copy and sign in. If it says “Almost there”, wait for the Partner's message, then pull down to refresh.
ch.end: You see Home and the Money tab.

ch.do: Open the training copy and sign in. Wait for “You are on” from the Partner.
ch.end: You see Home, Customers, Jobs and Tasks.

ch.do: Open the training copy and sign in.
ch.end: You see Home, Customers, Jobs and Tasks.

ch.t: Sign in and put Zuri on your phone
ch.do: Open the training copy in Chrome, sign in. Tap ⋮ → Add to Home screen. Open Zuri from the new icon.
ch.end: Zuri opens from the icon. Bottom tabs: Jobs, Tasks, Me.

ch.t: Sign in and put Zuri on your phone
ch.do: Open the training copy, sign in, Add to Home screen.
ch.end: Zuri opens from the icon.

ch.t: Sign in and put Zuri on your phone
ch.do: Open the training copy, sign in, Add to Home screen.
ch.end: Zuri opens from the icon.

ch.do: Admin → 💲 Price list. Add four packages: Home 5 Mbps 1500 · Home 10 Mbps 2000 · Home 20 Mbps 3000 · Business 30 Mbps 4500 (kind Fixed). The install fee is told to customers: Home 2,500, Business 4,500.
ch.end: Four packages in the list. (Call center sees them when they type a package on a new customer.)

ch.do: Admin → Company & hubs → ＋ Add a hub. Main office (Office / HQ), area Town Centre, landmark “Above the stage”, tap the map near the town centre. Then OLT room (OLT / server room, Town Centre). Then Satellite cabinet (Splitter cabinet, area Satellite).
ch.end: Three hubs with pins (no red “no pin”). Customers → 🗺️ Map shows the three hub icons.

ch.do: Money → 💵 Today → Count the cash. Area Town Centre: Bank 250000, M-Pesa 40000 → Save. Again for Satellite: Bank 60000, M-Pesa 12000 → Save.
ch.end: Cash today shows both areas. Satellite has an orange warning: M-Pesa float below the 15,000 target. Tell the Partner in the group.

ch.do: Money → 📋 Bills → Staff & pay → ＋ Add a staff member, once for each person: Finance officer 25,000 · Call center 18,000 (two) · Field technician 20,000 (three). Use the tester's name, M-Pesa number 0700 000 901 … 906 (pretend), pay day 21, tick “Working for Zuri now”. The Partner is not on the payroll.
ch.end: Six staff, total KES 121,000 a month, all “paid on the 21st”. (PRETEND salaries — your real Business Week pay is separate.)

ch.do: The Customer voice calls you as Grace Wanjiku. SEARCH first (no one yet). Customers → ＋ New customer: Full name Grace Wanjiku (Mama Wanjiku), Area Town Centre, Status Lead, Phone 0700 000 101, Billing website ID BW-1001, Package Home 10 Mbps (pick it from the list), Monthly rate 2000, Directions “Behind the Total petrol station, green gate”. Save. Then ＋ New job: New install, “Install Home 10 Mbps”, Send to tech Tech 1, Visit day tomorrow.
ch.where: Customers → ＋ New customer, then ＋ New job
ch.end: Grace Wanjiku is a Lead with a New install job for tomorrow, sent to Tech 1. Tell her: 2,000 a month + 2,500 install.

ch.do: Phone Call center 1. “Habari, I am Grace Wanjiku, they call me Mama Wanjiku. 0700 000 101. I live behind the Total petrol station, green gate. I want internet at home — what do you have?” Choose Home 10 Mbps. Ask “When can you come?”
ch.where: Phone call (or WhatsApp) to Call center 1
ch.end: They told you 2,000 a month + 2,500 install, gave you a day (tomorrow) and a technician's name. Tick ✅ — or ❌ and say what was missing.

ch.do: Money → ✍️ Record → Money out. Area Town Centre. Paid to Wavetech Solutions. Amount 35000. Category Equipment / Inventory. Paid from Bank. Ref WT-4471. Open “More details”: VAT included 4828, Supplier KRA PIN P051111111A, receipt Paper receipt — filed. Save.
ch.end: It shows “waiting for a second person's OK”. The Partner approves it (10:30). Then it shows in the list as approved.

ch.do: Finance records 10 routers (KES 35,000). Open Money → 📋 Bills → 👥 Approvals. Read it (who recorded it, the amount, the VAT). Tap ✅ Approve.
ch.end: “✅ Approved: Wavetech Solutions, KES 35,000.” Nothing left waiting.

ch.do: You bought fuel for the motorbike. Me → 📸 Snap a receipt → 📩 Paste M-Pesa message. Paste the message (Copy button below) → Read the message. What was it for: Transport / Fuel. Area Town Centre. ✅ Save.
ch.end: “✅ Saved.” Me → 🧾 My receipts shows Total Energies 500 waiting for Finance.
ch.copy: UKA1BWFUEL Confirmed. Ksh500.00 paid to TOTAL ENERGIES MAAI MAHIU. on 17/10/26 at 10:20 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh9,500.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

ch.do: Money → 📋 Bills → Add a bill, six times: Town Centre — Office rent 15000 due 21 (Rent & Utilities) · Safaricom backhaul 35000 due 23 (Telecom / Network) · KPLC prepaid 4000 due 19 · Staff transport 3000 due 21 (Transport / Fuel). Satellite — Pole rent 2500 due 22 · KPLC prepaid 2000 due 19. Put the “Pay to” from your role card.
ch.end: Bills for October: six bills, KES 61,500 owing, none paid.

ch.do: Mercy Atieno, Area Satellite, Lead, 0700 000 201, BW-2001, Home 10 Mbps, 2000, “Satellite estate, blue gate”. ＋ New job: New install, Tech 3, Visit day tomorrow.
ch.end: Mercy: Lead + install tomorrow with Tech 3.

ch.do: Phone Call center 2. “I am Mercy Atieno, 0700 000 201, Satellite estate, blue gate. I want 10 Mbps.”
ch.end: A day and a technician (Tech 3) for tomorrow.

ch.do: Jobs → ＋ Log a job: Site survey, “Market area: which shops want business internet”. Open it. Stand outside, tap 📍 Drop pin here. Add a photo of anything (pretend it is the market cabinet).
ch.where: Jobs → ＋ Log a job → the job
ch.end: The job has a pin and a photo.

ch.do: Jobs → ＋ Log a job: Site survey, “Satellite: cabinet to the estate gate, 400 m of drop cable needed”. Drop a pin outside. Add a photo.
ch.end: Survey job with a pin and a photo.

ch.do: Same steps: John Kamau, Town Centre, Lead, 0700 000 102, BW-1002, Home 5 Mbps, 1500, “Near the matatu stage, blue door”. Install job for tomorrow, Tech 1. He asks: “Can I pay by M-Pesa?” — Yes, to the tech, who types the code.
ch.end: John Kamau: Lead + install job tomorrow, Tech 1.

ch.do: Phone Call center 1. “John Kamau, 0700 000 102, near the matatu stage, blue door. The cheapest one. Can I pay the install by M-Pesa?”
ch.end: Home 5 Mbps, 1,500 a month; yes M-Pesa to the technician; install tomorrow.

ch.do: Money → 📋 Bills → 👥 Approvals. Tech 1's receipt (Total Energies, 500) is waiting. Look at the photo/message, then ✅ Approve. Not there yet? Tech 1 has not snapped it. Tap ⏭ Later and come back in 15 minutes.
ch.end: Nothing waiting. Money out shows Total Energies 500 recorded by Tech 1.

ch.t: Give the team their first tasks
ch.do: Tasks → ＋ Add a task: “Book every install for tomorrow with a tech and a time” → Call center, High. Then “Pay day is the 21st — check Staff & pay” → Finance.
ch.end: Both tasks show under Team with the right group.

ch.do: Faith Achieng (Faith Salon), Town Centre, Lead, 0700 000 103, BW-1003, Business 30 Mbps, 4500, “Market, shop 14”. Install job for tomorrow (Sunday afternoon), Tech 2, Priority Urgent (she wants it before her Monday customers). Business install fee is 4,500.
ch.end: Faith's Salon: Lead + urgent install tomorrow, Tech 2.

ch.do: Jobs → My jobs. Open each install for tomorrow. Read the customer, directions and package.
ch.end: Mama Wanjiku and John Kamau are in your list for tomorrow (Later).

ch.do: Phone Call center 1. “Faith Achieng, Faith's Salon, Market shop 14, 0700 000 103. I need fast internet for the salon. Please come tomorrow — I open again on Monday morning.”
ch.end: Business 30 Mbps, 4,500 a month + 4,500 install; urgent install tomorrow afternoon.

ch.do: My jobs → Faith's Salon (tomorrow, urgent). Read it. Note the install fee for a business: 4,500.
ch.end: Faith's Salon is in your list for tomorrow, marked urgent.

ch.do: My jobs → Mercy Atieno's install (tomorrow). Read the directions.
ch.end: Mercy's install shows for tomorrow.

ch.do: Money → 👥 Customers → Next 30 days. Find the day your cash is lowest. Write down that day and the amount.
ch.end: A day-by-day list. Write in your Testers' List note: the lowest cash and the day. (If Customers is empty, that is fine: the call center has not added any yet, so the list only has bills.)

ch.do: The Customer voice asks: “How much are your hotspot vouchers?” We don't have a hotspot price list yet. Don't make a customer. Tasks → ＋ Add a task: “Caller asked hotspot voucher prices — what do we say?” Who: Partners.
ch.end: A task for the Partners. No new customer.

ch.do: Jobs → ＋ Log a job: Site survey, “Walked Town Centre: poles from the office to the market cabinet”. Save. Open it, add a note “Pole at the market leaning — check”.
ch.end: Your survey job is in My jobs with your note under NOTES.

ch.do: Phone Call center 2. “How much are your hotspot vouchers?” (You are not a customer.)
ch.end: They did not make you a customer. They said they will find out (a task for the Partners).

ch.do: Home → tap the 🏢 Headquarters card. Read Needs a decision, then Areas side by side, then Live activity (Last 24 hours). Scroll to The team.
ch.end: Both areas (Town Centre, Satellite) are in the table. Today's new customers and jobs are in Live activity, with who did them. Everyone you switched on is in The team.

ch.do: Money → 📊 Report. Read THE REPORT. It should show Town Centre and Satellite with today's cash counts.
ch.end: The report shows both areas with Bank and M-Pesa numbers counted today, and the bills owing.

ch.t: Check every job has a tech and a day
ch.do: Jobs → All techs. Look at each job.
ch.end: Every job shows 👷 a tech and 📅 a day. None says “Not yet”.

ch.do: Tomorrow you install Mama Wanjiku. Her directions say “behind the Total petrol station, green gate”. But you know there are THREE green gates behind that station. You want her exact place before you go. What do you do?
ch.hint: Jobs → My jobs → under Later open Grace Wanjiku's install. If you see 💬 Ask customer for location, tap it and send the message. If you can't see her phone (techs may not see phones yet), Notes: “Need exact location — which green gate?” → Add. Then Tasks → ＋ Add a task: “Ask Mama Wanjiku to send her WhatsApp location before tomorrow 2 pm” → Who should do it? Call center → Add task.
ch.end: The install job has your note (or the location request was sent), and Call center has your task (Tasks → Team).

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: A cable hanging low over the road
ch.do: On your way home you see a Zuri cable hanging very low across the road at the market. A lorry could pull it down and cut Faith's Salon tomorrow. You can't fix it alone today. What do you do?
ch.hint: Jobs → ＋ Log a job: Type of job Other, “Cable hanging low across the road at the market — needs lifting / a taller pole”, Priority Urgent → Save job. On the job: 📍 Drop pin here (stand under the cable) and 📷 Add photo. Tell the Partner in the team group.
ch.end: A new urgent (🔴) job in your My jobs with a pin and a photo — the office can see it in Jobs.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: A padlock for the cabinet
ch.do: The Satellite cabinet has no lock. You buy a padlock for KES 450 cash at the hardware shop in Satellite. The shop gives you a small paper receipt. What do you do so you get your 450 back?
ch.hint: Me → 📸 Snap a receipt → 📸 Take a photo of the receipt (the paper). Paid to: Satellite Hardware. Amount 450. What was it for? Equipment / Inventory. Area Satellite. Paid with: 💵 Cash. More → What was bought: Padlock for the Satellite cabinet. ✅ Save.
ch.end: Me → 🧾 My receipts shows Satellite Hardware 450 with 📷, waiting for Finance.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: A Satellite caller on your line
ch.do: A woman calls YOUR line: “I am Joyce Wangari. I live in Satellite, behind the borehole kiosk. I want the cheapest internet. But I get my salary on the 25th — please come after that.” What do you do?
ch.hint: 1) Customers → search “Joyce” and her phone first (no doubles). 2) ＋ New customer: Full name Joyce Wangari, Area Satellite (not Town Centre!), Status Lead, Phone 0700 000 208, Package / plan Home 5 Mbps, Monthly rate 1500, Directions “Satellite, behind the borehole kiosk” → Save customer. 3) ＋ New job: New install, “Install Home 5 Mbps — after her pay day”, Send to tech: Tech 3 (the Satellite tech), Visit day Mon 26 Oct → Save job. 4) Tell her: 1,500 a month + 2,500 install, a technician comes on Monday the 26th.
ch.end: Joyce Wangari is a Lead in SATELLITE with a New install job on 26 Oct sent to Tech 3. She heard the price (1,500 a month + 2,500 install).

ch.t: 🎭 Problem call: Joyce from Satellite (to Call center 1)
ch.do: Phone Call center 1 — the Town Centre desk, on purpose — as Joyce Wangari, a new customer from Satellite.
ch.where: Phone call (or WhatsApp) to Call center 1
say: Habari! I am Joyce Wangari, 0700 000 208.
I live in Satellite, behind the borehole kiosk.
I want the cheapest internet you have. How much?
But please — I get my salary on the 25th. Come after that, not before.
ch.check: They did not just say “call the other number”. They took your name and number, told you 1,500 a month + 2,500 install, and gave you a day after the 25th (Monday 26th) with the Satellite technician.
ch.end: They did not just say “call the other number”. They took your name and number, told you 1,500 a month + 2,500 install, and gave you a day after the 25th (Monday 26th) with the Satellite technician.

ch.do: Customers → 🗺️ Map. Find the Satellite cabinet hub.
ch.end: The map shows the hubs the Partner added (office, OLT room, Satellite cabinet).

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: Tech 3 can't see his job
ch.do: Tech 3 sends you a WhatsApp: “Boss, I am signed in, but my list is empty. I can't see Mercy's install for tomorrow!” Mercy's install was booked this morning. What do you check, and what do you tell him?
ch.hint: 1) Me → ⚙️ Admin → People: find Tech 3. Job = Field tech, Area = Satellite, On is ticked → Save. 2) Jobs → in the All techs box pick Tech 3: Mercy Atieno's install should be there with 📅 tomorrow. If it shows no 👷 tech, open it → Who's going, and when → Tech: Tech 3 → Save. 3) Tell Tech 3: pull down to refresh — tomorrow's jobs are under “Later”, below “Today”. Set the box back to All techs.
ch.end: Tech 3 is On as Field tech in Satellite. Jobs (All techs → Tech 3) shows Mercy's install with 👷 Tech 3 and 📅 tomorrow, and Tech 3 says he can see it under Later.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: A printer bought with cash
ch.do: The Partner bought a small printer for the office at Naivas: KES 8,500, paid in cash. The paper receipt is in your drawer. The Partner says: “Please put it in the books.” What do you do?
ch.hint: Money → ✍️ Record → Money out. Area Town Centre. Paid to: Naivas. Amount 8500. Category: Equipment / Inventory. Paid from: Cash. Receipt: Paper receipt — filed (or tap 📸 Snap a receipt and photograph it). Open “More details — approval, VAT, note” → Note: Office printer. Save expense. It waits for a second person's OK — tell the Partner.
ch.end: Money out shows Naivas 8,500 · Equipment / Inventory · Cash, with a receipt, waiting for a second OK. 👥 Approvals shows it under “You recorded — waiting for someone else”.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: Mercy can only be home after 2 pm
ch.do: Mercy Atieno calls again: “Tomorrow I am at church until 1 pm. Please tell the technician to come after 2 pm, not in the morning.” What do you do so the technician really knows?
ch.hint: Customers → search Mercy → open her → under Jobs open her install job. Notes: “Customer at church until 1 pm — come after 2 pm” → Add. Then 💬 Tell Tech 3 on WhatsApp (under “Who's going, and when”) and add the time to the message. (Zuri keeps a day, not a time — the note is where the time lives.)
ch.end: Mercy's install job has your note about 2 pm, and Tech 3 got a WhatsApp message. The visit day is still tomorrow.

ch.t: 🎭 Problem call: Mercy: come after 2 pm (to Call center 2)
ch.do: Phone Call center 2 as Mercy Atieno (you booked an install this morning).
ch.where: Phone call (or WhatsApp) to Call center 2
say: Habari, it's Mercy Atieno again, 0700 000 201, Satellite estate.
Tomorrow I am at church until 1 pm.
Please tell your technician to come after 2 pm. Will he know?
ch.check: They found you without asking for everything again, promised the technician will come after 2 pm, and said they wrote it on your job or told the technician.
ch.end: They found you without asking for everything again, promised the technician will come after 2 pm, and said they wrote it on your job or told the technician.

days.title: First installs
days.story: Yesterday's four customers get connected. Six more call. The techs collect install fees and buy cable; Finance checks every shilling; the Partner puts the network on the map.

ch.do: My jobs → Grace Wanjiku. ▶ I'm starting now (say yes to the pin if Zuri asks). Parts: ONT router, serial HWT10010001, qty 1. 📷 a photo. What did you do: Ran new cable + Tested — working. Did the customer pay you: 💵 Cash 2500. ✅ Job finished.
ch.end: The job is Done. NOTES: “Job done · collected KES 2,500 (cash)”. The router serial is under PARTS.

ch.do: Faith's Salon. ▶ I'm starting now. Router serial HWT30010001. 📷 photo of the router on the wall. What did you do: Ran new cable + Tested — working. 📱 M-Pesa 4500, code UKF3SALN45. ✅ Job finished — by 15:00.
ch.end: Done by 15:00. Collected KES 4,500 (mpesa) UKF3SALN45.

ch.do: Mercy's install. ▶ I'm starting now. Router HWT10020001. 📷 photo. Did: Ran new cable + Tested — working. 💵 Cash 2500. ✅ Job finished.
ch.end: Done, collected KES 2,500 (cash).

ch.do: SEARCH, then ＋ New customer: Peter Mwangi, Town Centre, Lead, 0700 000 104, BW-1004, Home 20 Mbps, 3000, “Opposite St. Mary's church”. Install job tomorrow (Monday morning), Tech 1.
ch.end: Peter: Lead + install tomorrow, Tech 1.

ch.do: Phone Call center 1. “Peter Mwangi, 0700 000 104, opposite St. Mary's church. The 20 Mbps, please. Monday morning is good.”
ch.end: Install booked for Monday morning with a technician.

ch.do: Customers: leave the status box on Active. Search “Grace”.
ch.end: Grace Wanjiku shows (as a Lead) with the note “Searching every status”. If she does NOT show, tap ❌: people will get added twice.

ch.do: Admin → Who sees what. Field techs: tick Phone and Package. Leave Monthly rate and National ID unticked for field techs.
ch.end: Field techs see Phone and Package, not the rate or ID.

ch.do: Count the cash both areas: Town Centre Bank 215000, M-Pesa 40000. Satellite Bank 60000, M-Pesa 12000. (The 35,000 for routers left the bank yesterday.)
ch.end: Two counts with today's date.

ch.t: Lucy Njeri calls — wants it today
ch.do: Lucy Njeri, Town Centre, Lead, 0700 000 105, BW-1005, Home 10 Mbps, 2000, “Above the M-Pesa shop”. Install job TODAY, Tech 1. 💬 Tell Tech 1 on WhatsApp (from the job page).
ch.end: Lucy's install is today with Tech 1, and Tech 1 got the WhatsApp message.

ch.do: Phone Call center 1. “Lucy Njeri, 0700 000 105, above the M-Pesa shop. I need it TODAY, I work from home.” Be a bit impatient.
ch.end: They booked today (Tech 1) and stayed polite.

ch.do: Tap Me → ⚙️ Admin → Custom fields. In Field name type: Router serial. Kind: Text. Tap Add field — Router serial now shows in the list above. Then tap Who sees what. Find “Router serial (custom)”: it is already ticked for Call center, so leave it ticked.
ch.end: Router serial is a field the call center can fill on a customer. (Techs record serials under the job's Parts.)

ch.do: Mama Wanjiku and John Kamau are connected. Open each customer → ✏️ Edit → Status Active, Install date today → Save customer.
ch.end: Both show Active with today's install date.

ch.do: Joseph Kibet, Satellite, Lead, 0700 000 202, BW-2002, Home 5 Mbps, 1500, “Satellite, near the borehole”. Install TODAY, Tech 3.
ch.end: Joseph: Lead + install today with Tech 3.

ch.do: Phone Call center 2. “Joseph Kibet, 0700 000 202, Satellite near the borehole. Cheapest package.”
ch.end: Install today with Tech 3.

ch.do: John Kamau's install. Same steps. Router serial HWT10010002. 📱 M-Pesa 2500, code UKJ2JOHN25. ✅ Job finished.
ch.end: Done, “collected KES 2,500 (mpesa)”, code UKJ2JOHN25.

ch.do: Purity Nyambura, Satellite, Lead, 0700 000 203, BW-2003, Home 20 Mbps, 3000, “Satellite shops, 2nd floor”. Install TODAY, Tech 3.
ch.end: Purity: Lead + install today with Tech 3.

ch.do: Phone Call center 2. “Purity Nyambura, 0700 000 203, Satellite shops, 2nd floor. 20 Mbps.”
ch.end: Install today.

ch.do: Tasks → find “Caller asked hotspot voucher prices”. 💬 Notes: “Hotspot not sold yet — say coming soon”. Tick it.
ch.end: The task is Done with your note.

ch.do: 👥 Approvals: Tech 1's Kamau Hardware 1,800 and Tech 3's fuel 700. ✅ Approve each. Not there yet? The techs have not snapped them. Tap ⏭ Later and come back in 15 minutes.
ch.end: Nothing waiting.

ch.do: When Call center books the hotel survey for you: open it, ▶ I'm starting now, 📍 pin at the gate. Under “What did you do?” write: Surveyed — needs 2 access points (reception + rooms block). ✅ Job finished.
ch.end: Survey Done with a pin and what you found.

ch.do: Snap the receipt (copy below). Transport / Fuel. Area Satellite.
ch.end: Total Energies 700 in My receipts.
ch.copy: UKC3BWFUEL Confirmed. Ksh700.00 paid to TOTAL ENERGIES MAAI MAHIU. on 18/10/26 at 3:25 PM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh8,800.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

ch.do: Daniel Kiprono (Longonot View Hotel), Town Centre, Lead, 0700 000 106, BW-1006, Business 30 Mbps, 4500, “Old Naivasha road, after the bridge”. Make a Site survey job TODAY for Tech 2, and a New install job for tomorrow for Tech 2.
ch.end: Hotel: Lead, a survey today and an install tomorrow, both Tech 2.

ch.do: Phone Call center 1. “Daniel Kiprono, manager, Longonot View Hotel on the old Naivasha road, 0700 000 106. We need internet in reception and the rooms.”
ch.end: A survey today and an install tomorrow; business price 4,500/month + 4,500 install.

ch.do: Customers → Faith's Salon → PAYMENTS. Then Mama Wanjiku. Then John Kamau.
ch.end: Each shows the install money the tech collected (4,500 / 2,500 / 2,500), source field.

ch.do: Me → 📸 Snap a receipt → 📩 Paste M-Pesa message (copy below) → Read. What was it for: Equipment / Inventory. ✅ Save.
ch.end: Kamau Hardware 1,800 in 🧾 My receipts, waiting for Finance.
ch.copy: UKB2BWCABL Confirmed. Ksh1,800.00 paid to KAMAU HARDWARE. on 18/10/26 at 3:58 PM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh7,700.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

ch.t: Fix a mistake: delete a wrong entry
ch.do: Money → Money out: record KES 100, payee “TEST — delete me”, Cash. Then find it in the list below and tap ✕ to delete it.
ch.end: It is gone from the list and from Cash today. The totals are the same as before.

ch.t: Mama Wanjiku: forgot the WiFi password

ch.end: A low-priority fault job for Tech 2.

ch.do: Phone Call center 1 as Mama Wanjiku: “The internet works, but I forgot the WiFi password!”
ch.end: A (low) job for a technician today — or they helped you on the phone. Either is OK.

ch.t: Install Joseph Kibet / Purity Nyambura (if booked today)
ch.do: Do whichever Satellite installs Call center 2 booked for today. Routers HWT10020002, HWT10020003. Joseph pays 💵 2,500 cash; Purity 📱 2,500 code UKP4PURI25.
ch.end: Each install Done with the money and router serial.

ch.do: Esther Wairimu, Town Centre, Lead, 0700 000 107, BW-1007, Home 5 Mbps, 1500, “Near the health centre”. Install tomorrow, Tech 2.
ch.end: Esther: Lead + install tomorrow.

ch.t: Mercy is connected — make her Active
ch.do: Mercy Atieno → ✏️ Edit → Status Active, Install date today → Save.
ch.end: Mercy shows Active.

ch.t: Mama Wanjiku forgot her WiFi password
ch.do: Call center sends you a job for Mama Wanjiku (low). Found: Wrong settings / password. Did: Fixed settings + Showed customer how to pay. No money. ✅ Job finished.
ch.end: Done, no money collected.

ch.do: Phone Call center 1. “Esther Wairimu, 0700 000 107, near the health centre. The small one, 5 Mbps.”
ch.end: Install tomorrow.

ch.t: Lucy Njeri's install (if booked for today)
ch.do: If Call center booked Lucy for today: install her. Router HWT10010003. She pays install AND her first month together: 📱 M-Pesa 4500, code UKL5LUCY45. ✅ Job finished.
ch.end: Done, collected KES 4,500 (mpesa) UKL5LUCY45. (Lucy will ask about this on day 4.)

ch.t: Message the Satellite team from Headquarters
ch.do: 🏢 Headquarters → ✉️ Message… → tap the Satellite button → write: Habari {name}, asante for today! → Next: send → send it on WhatsApp to each person (one tap each, then press Send in WhatsApp).
ch.end: Each person got the message with THEIR first name (not “{name}”). A ✅ shows next to each one you sent.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: All the lights are off
ch.do: Mama Wanjiku calls, worried: “My internet is dead! All the lights on the box are off!” Before you send a technician on a Sunday evening, what do you ask her — and what do you put in Zuri?
ch.hint: Ask: “Is there power in the house? Are the lights and TV on?” (She finds KPLC is off.) No tech visit. But every call goes into Zuri: Customers → Grace Wanjiku → ＋ New job: Fault / no internet, “All router lights off”, Priority Low, Send to tech: Not yet — decide later → Save job. On the job under The work: What did you find? tap No power at the house. What did you do? type “Advised on the phone — wait for KPLC”. ✅ Job finished.
ch.end: Grace has a fault job that is Done with “No power at the house” — and no technician was sent.

ch.do: Your fibre cleaver (the tool that cuts the fibre clean) falls and breaks. A new one costs about KES 6,500 in Naivasha. Without it you cannot do installs on Monday. Do you buy it yourself today, or what? What do you do?
ch.hint: Don't spend 6,500 without the office's OK. Tasks → ＋ Add a task: “Fibre cleaver broken — need a new one (about 6,500, Naivasha) before Monday's installs” → Who should do it? Partners → Priority High → Due tomorrow → Add task. Tell the Partner in the team group too.
ch.end: The Partners have a High task from you with the price and the deadline.

ch.t: 🎭 Problem call: Mama Wanjiku: all lights off (to Call center 1)
ch.do: Phone Call center 1 as Mama Wanjiku. Sound worried.
ch.where: Phone call (or WhatsApp) to Call center 1
say: Hello, Mama Wanjiku here, 0700 000 101.
My internet is dead! All the lights on the box are off!
ONLY if they ask about power: “Wait… the TV is also off. Oh — KPLC has cut the power again!”
If they don't ask about power: “Send someone now!”
ch.check: They asked about power BEFORE sending anyone, and did not send a technician for a power cut. Ask “Did you write it down?” — they should say yes.
ch.end: They asked about power BEFORE sending anyone, and did not send a technician for a power cut. Ask “Did you write it down?” — they should say yes.

ch.do: Home. Read Zuri at a glance and Needs attention.
ch.end: Write in your note one thing on Home that helps you, and one thing that is confusing.

ch.do: Money → ✍️ Record → Money in: Area Town Centre, What for Equipment sale, Amount 3500, Received into M-Pesa, From “Walk-in customer”, Ref UKS6ROUT35. Save cash in.
ch.end: Equipment sale +3,500 in this month's list.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: The hotel offers you cash
ch.do: At the hotel survey, Daniel says: “Put a second access point in the rooms block today. I will pay you cash now — how much?” Nobody told you a price for this. What do you do?
ch.hint: Don't take money for work with no price. On the hotel survey job, Notes: “Daniel wants a 2nd access point in the rooms block — asked the price, told him the office will call” → Add. Then Tasks → ＋ Add a task: “Longonot View Hotel wants a 2nd access point — price?” → Who should do it? Partners → Add task.
ch.end: The survey job has your note, a task asks the Partners for a price, and no money is recorded on the job.

ch.do: Jobs → All techs → pick Tech 3.
ch.end: Tech 3 has Mercy (Done) and Joseph + Purity. Set the filter back to All techs.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: John's router is getting hot
ch.do: John Kamau phones YOU directly: “The router you put in today is very hot and it switched off two times!” You go back and change it for a new one, serial HWT10010011. The old one goes back to the office. What do you do in Zuri?
ch.hint: Tell John: next time please also call the office line. Jobs → My jobs → Done → John Kamau's install. Parts & equipment used: Item “ONT router (replacement)”, Serial HWT10010011, Qty 1 → Add. Notes: “Old router HWT10010002 overheating — replaced, old one back to the office” → Add. (Techs can't link a new job to a customer — so use his job, or Tasks → ＋ Add a task for Call center to make a fault job.)
ch.end: John's install job shows HWT10010011 under Parts and a note that says why, and where the old router is.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: Faith wants to pay 3 months at once
ch.do: Faith of Faith's Salon phones you, the boss: “Business is good. Can I pay 3 months at once, 13,500, and get a discount?” Decide what Zuri does. Then make sure the office knows your answer, so nobody tells her something different next week. What do you do?
ch.hint: Decide (for example: yes to 3 months, no discount — or a small one). Customers → search Faith → open Faith Achieng (Faith Salon) → ✏️ Edit → Notes: your decision with the date, e.g. “18 Oct Partner: may pay 3 months (13,500), no discount” → Save customer. Then Tasks → ＋ Add a task: “Faith's Salon will pay 3 months — check it on the billing website” → Who should do it? Finance → Add task.
ch.end: Faith's customer page shows your decision in Notes, and Finance has a task about it. What you told Faith matches the note.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: Where is the install cash?
ch.do: At 5 pm Tech 1 gives you 2,500 cash from Mama Wanjiku's install. Tech 3 sends a message: “I have the cash from Mercy and Joseph, I bring it tomorrow.” You want to know from Zuri — not from memory — how much cash each tech collected today. What do you do?
ch.hint: Customers → open Grace Wanjiku → Payments: 2,500 cash (on a job). Then Mercy Atieno and Joseph Kibet → Payments. (Or open each Done install job: its Notes say “Job done · collected KES …”.) Add up: Tech 1 cash 2,500; Tech 3 cash 5,000 (if Joseph paid cash). Then Tasks → ＋ Add a task → Who: Tech 3 → “Bring the 5,000 install cash (Mercy + Joseph) to the office tomorrow” → Add task.
ch.end: You found each cash amount in Zuri, Tech 1's 2,500 is in the office, and Tech 3 has a task to bring his. In your note: was it easy to find?

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: Joseph wants proof he paid
ch.do: Joseph Kibet calls: “Your technician took 2,500 cash for my install and gave me no receipt. How do I know Zuri got my money?” What do you do?
ch.hint: Customers → search Joseph → open him → Payments: 2,500 cash (on a job) — or open his install job: Notes say “Job done · collected KES 2,500 (cash)”. Tell him the amount and the date. On his install job, Notes: “Customer asked for proof — confirmed 2,500 cash received” → Add. (If the payment is NOT there: Tasks → ＋ Add a task for Finance with the details.)
ch.end: Joseph heard the amount from Zuri, and his install job has your note. If the money was missing, Finance has a task.

ch.t: 🎭 Problem call: Joseph wants proof (to Call center 2)
ch.do: Phone Call center 2 as Joseph Kibet (installed today).
ch.where: Phone call (or WhatsApp) to Call center 2
say: Joseph Kibet, 0700 000 202, Satellite near the borehole.
Your technician took 2,500 cash from me today for the install.
He gave me no receipt! How do I know Zuri got my money?
ch.check: They looked it up and told you the amount and the day (2,500, today) — not just “don't worry”. They said they wrote it down.
ch.end: They looked it up and told you the amount and the day (2,500, today) — not just “don't worry”. They said they wrote it down.

ch.hint: First check 👥 Approvals and Money out: nothing from Kamau Hardware for 600. Ask Tech 1: Tasks → ＋ Add a task → Who: Tech 1 → “Kamau Hardware says you took 3 connectors on credit (600). True?” → Add task. (600 is under the 1,000 rule, so it saves straight away.)
ch.end: Tech 1 has your task. Once he confirmed, Money out has Kamau Hardware 600 with a note — and it did not need the Partner.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: A cheaper router deal

Write down that day and the amount. Decide. Then remove the one-off (×). Tasks → ＋ Add a task for Finance: “Wavetech offer 64,000 by Fri: YES / NO — lowest cash would be …” → Add task.
ch.end: You saw the lowest cash with the 64,000 in it, the one-off is removed again, and Finance has a task with your decision and the reason.

ch.hint: Don't promise a document you can't make. Find the payment: Customers → Isaac Ndungu (Satellite Academy) → Payments / the install job (4,500, UKI8ACAD45). On the install job, Notes: “School needs an official receipt with KRA PIN by Fri — email accounts@satacademy.example” → Add. Tasks → ＋ Add a task: “Satellite Academy needs an official receipt for 4,500 (UKI8ACAD45) with our KRA PIN, by email before Friday” → Who should do it? Finance → Add task.
ch.end: Finance has a task with the amount, the code, the email and the deadline. The school's job has your note.

say: Good morning, Isaac Ndungu, Satellite Academy, 0700 000 204.
You installed us today. Our accountant paid 4,500.
We need an OFFICIAL receipt with your KRA PIN, sent by email before Friday. The email is accounts@satacademy.example.

ch.do: 👥 Approvals: both KPLC payments and Tech 3's receipts. ✅ Approve each.

ch.do: Stephen Mutua, SA, 0700 000 206, BW-2006, Home 5 Mbps, 1500, “Near the chief's camp”. Install tomorrow (day 5), Tech 3.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: Faith's router died after the power came back
ch.do: Faith's Salon calls you: after KPLC came back, the router is dead. You go: it is burnt (power surge). You put in a new router, serial HWT30010009. Faith asks: “Who pays for the new router?” What do you do?
ch.hint: Jobs → ＋ Log a job: Fault / no internet, “Faith's Salon: router burnt after a power surge”, Priority Urgent → Save job. What did you find? Router off / faulty. What did you do? Replaced router + Tested — working. Parts: ONT router, Serial HWT30010009 → Add. Notes: “Old router HWT30010001 burnt — brought back”. ✅ Job finished (no money). Tasks → ＋ Add a task: “Who pays for Faith's new router (surge)?” → Who should do it? Partners → Add task. Tell Faith the office will answer.
ch.end: A Done job with the new serial in Parts and a note about the old router, plus a task for the Partners. No money taken.

ch.do: Snap two receipts (copy below, then the second from your role card): Fibre World 1,200 (Equipment / Inventory) and fuel 600.

ch.copy: UKE5BWSLEV Confirmed. Ksh1,200.00 paid to FIBRE WORLD NAIVASHA. on 20/10/26 at 11:40 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh5,100.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

ch.t: Look 30 days ahead with a one-off
ch.do: Money → Next 30 days → One-off money in or out: tomorrow, −50,000, “TEST generator” → add. Find the day your cash is lowest and write down the amount. Then remove the one-off.
ch.end: The lowest point drops by 50,000 while it is there, and goes back when you remove it.

ch.hint: Jobs → ＋ Log a job: Other, “OLT room on battery 30% — KPLC off since 11:30”, Priority Urgent → Save job. 📷 Add photo of the battery screen, 📍 Drop pin here. Tasks → ＋ Add a task: “OLT room battery low — generator or KPLC token? Check now” → Who should do it? Partners → Priority Urgent → Add task. Phone the Partner too.
ch.end: An urgent job with a photo and a pin, and an Urgent task for the Partners. The Partner heard from you within minutes.

ch.do: When Tech 1 finishes Pastor Moses: Status Active + install date.
ch.end: Pastor Moses is Active.

ch.do: The hotel refund (4,500) went to a wrong number. M-Pesa reversed it, so the money is back in our M-Pesa. Daniel gives you the right number and you send it again: new code UKRAHOTL45. Zuri still shows the first refund. What do you do so the books show ONE refund — not two, not zero?

Then record the new one: Town Centre, Paid to “Longonot View Hotel — refund”, 4500, Other, M-Pesa, code UKRAHOTL45, Note “First try reversed — wrong number” → Save expense. It waits for the Partner's OK again — tell the Partner. (If Zuri won't let you delete the old one, tap ❌ and say so.)
ch.end: Money out has ONE hotel refund of 4,500 (UKRAHOTL45) with your note, waiting for a second OK. The old one is gone.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: Everybody is back — except Joseph

ch.hint: Everyone else is back, so it is probably not the cable — Joseph's package ran out yesterday (he says he paid). Don't rush there. Tasks → ＋ Add a task: “Joseph Kibet still off after the outage — is it his payment (UKJ7JOSE15) or a fault? Make a fault job for me if needed” → Who should do it? Call center → Priority High → Add task. Tell Joseph the office will check now and call him.
ch.end: Call center has your High task about Joseph. You did not drive there for nothing.

ch.do: When Tech 3 says service is back: ✅ Service is back — close it.
ch.end: The red box is gone. Tell Call center 2.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: Road works cut our cable

ch.hint: Don't pay the foreman. Me → ⚙️ Admin → Company & hubs → Satellite cabinet → ✏️ Edit → Note (keys, contact, power…): “Road works 50 m before the cabinet until early Nov — cable cut 20 Oct” → Save the hub. Then Tasks → ＋ Add a task: “Mark our cable route for the road works / talk to the county engineer” → Who: Technical or Tech 3 → Priority High → Add task.
ch.end: The Satellite cabinet hub has your note and there is a High task to protect the cable. No 5,000 paid.

ch.do: Phone Call center 2 as Mercy: “It's back, asante!”
ch.end: They thanked you; Mercy's fault job is Done.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: The school wants money back
ch.do: Isaac of Satellite Academy calls: “The internet was off for two hours during our exams! I want a discount on this month.” You are not allowed to give discounts. What do you do?
ch.hint: Say sorry and explain (the road works cut the cable; it is fixed). Don't promise money. Jobs → Done → his Urgent fault job from this morning → Notes: “Asks for a discount: 2 hours down during exams” → Add. Tasks → ＋ Add a task: “Satellite Academy asks for a discount after the 20 Oct outage (2 h, exams) — decide” → Who should do it? Partners → Priority High → Add task. Tell him a partner will call him.
ch.end: His fault job has your note and the Partners have a High task. You did not promise a discount.

ch.t: 🎭 Problem call: The school wants a discount (to Call center 2)

say: Isaac Ndungu, Satellite Academy, 0700 000 204.
Your internet was off for two hours this morning — during our ONLINE EXAMS!
I want a discount on this month's bill. What will you do?
ch.check: They said sorry, explained what happened, did not promise a discount themselves, and told you a partner will call you.
ch.end: They said sorry, explained what happened, did not promise a discount themselves, and told you a partner will call you.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: John is moving house

Tasks → ＋ Add a task: “John Kamau moves 24 Oct — what is our moving fee?” → Who should do it? Partners → Add task. Tell John honestly: the office calls him with the price today.
ch.end: John has a Move connection job on 24 Oct with Tech 1, and the Partners have a task about the fee. You did not invent a price.

ch.t: 🎭 Problem call: John is moving house (to Call center 1)

ch.where: Phone call (or WhatsApp) to Call center 1
say: John Kamau, 0700 000 102. Next Saturday I move to a new house on the Kamuyu road, near the posho mill.
Can you move my internet there? How much will it cost?
And I don't want to pay for days when I have no internet!
ch.check: They booked a day for the move (Saturday) and were honest about the price — they will find out and call back, not a made-up number.

days.title: Pay day and reports
days.story: The 21st: staff pay day, and time for the VAT figures. Morning follow-ups for customers who ran out, the cash count, the pay run with two people, the VAT figures and the Friday report — printed.

ch.do: Count the cash: Town Centre Bank 210500, M-Pesa 52300. Satellite Bank 60000, M-Pesa 14100.
ch.end: Two counts today. Satellite float is just below target — orange warning. Note it for the report.

ch.t: Today's texts — customers who ran out
ch.do: Jobs → 📩 Today's texts (if it is empty, tap Jobs → Check now first). Esther Wairimu: call the voice → she will pay Saturday → 🤝 Will pay → In 3 days → Save. Samuel Otieno: call → no answer → 📵 No answer.
ch.end: Esther: “Promised to pay by …”. Samuel: “Called — no answer”, back tomorrow.

ch.do: Router HWT10010009. 💵 Cash 2500. ✅ Job finished. If the follow-up said her old service ran out, ignore — she is new.
ch.end: Done.

ch.do: Router HWT10020005. 💵 Cash 2500. 📍 pin. ✅ Job finished.
ch.end: Done.

ch.do: Call center will call YOU today. Answer as: Esther Wairimu — “I will pay on Saturday.” Samuel Otieno — don't answer (let it ring). Peter Mwangi — “I'm moving to Naivasha, please stop it.” Joseph Kibet — “The office fixed it yesterday, thank you.”
ch.end: Each call ended with the right button in Zuri (ask them what they pressed).

ch.do: Jobs → 📍 Nearest first (allow location).
ch.end: The list orders itself by distance from where you stand.

ch.do: Money → 📋 Bills → Pay run → 🔄 Build today's list.
ch.end: Under PAY NOW: six staff salaries (121,000) and the bills due by the 24th (rent, transport, pole rent, backhaul).

ch.do: Joseph's payment follow-up: Finance linked his payment yesterday. ✅ Says paid.
ch.end: “Customer says they paid — check the next billing import.”

ch.do: For each line: ✅ Sent — record it, M-Pesa (Bank for rent and backhaul), code UKP1… (use your role card list: UKP1SAL001 … UKP1SAL006, UKP2RENT15, UKP3TRAN03, UKP4POLE25, UKP5BACK35). Record it.
ch.end: Every line shows ⏳ waiting for a second OK. Nothing says “paid” yet — that is correct.

ch.do: Peter's follow-up: call the voice → he is moving to Naivasha → ✋ Wants to stop → OK.
ch.end: Closed. “Office can disconnect on the billing website.”

ch.do: Start Kevin's install at 11:10 (you were late on purpose). Router HWT10010010. 📱 M-Pesa 2500 code UKK3KEVI25.
ch.end: Done with the M-Pesa code. The job shows the call center's note about the delay.

ch.t: Ann Muthoni: no internet after install?
ch.do: Ann calls (voice): no internet. Her install is today — check the job: is Tech 1 on the way? 💬 Tell Tech 1 on WhatsApp.
ch.end: Ann was told the time; Tech 1 got the message.

ch.do: Me → 🧾 My receipts. Every receipt this week: is it there? Any ❌? Snap it now.
ch.end: Only 📷 or 📱 — no ❌.

ch.t: Call — Ann: is the tech coming?
ch.do: Phone Call center 1 as Ann Muthoni: “When is the technician coming?”
ch.end: A clear time.

ch.t: Approve the pay run — two people
ch.do: 👥 Approvals. Approve every salary and bill EXCEPT Staff transport: ✋ Decline it with the reason “No receipt — snap it and send again”.
ch.end: Salaries and bills approved; Staff transport declined with your reason.

ch.do: Purity calls: slow in the evening since the outage. ＋ New job: Fault, “Slow in the evenings since Tuesday”, Priority Low, Tech 3, tomorrow.
ch.end: A low fault for tomorrow.

ch.do: If you didn't snap yesterday's fuel: snap it now (copy below), Transport / Fuel.
ch.end: Fuel 600 in My receipts.
ch.copy: UKE6BWFUEL Confirmed. Ksh600.00 paid to TOTAL ENERGIES MAAI MAHIU. on 20/10/26 at 11:44 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh4,500.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

ch.do: Phone Call center 2 as Purity: “Since Tuesday it is slow every evening.”

ch.end: No tech visit is made. A payment follow-up is made instead.

ch.copy: UKP3TRAN03 Confirmed. Ksh3,000.00 paid to MAAI MAHIU SACCO. on 21/10/26 at 10:40 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh49,300.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

ch.end: October so far: claimable VAT includes Wavetech 4,828 and Fibre World 345. Write the four numbers in your note. (The October return is due 20 Nov.)

ch.end: A note on the job; Tech 2 messaged.

ch.do: Tasks → My day. Tick what you did. Add a note on anything you could not do.
ch.end: My day up to date.

ch.t: Call — Kevin: the tech is late

ch.end: They checked and gave you a new time, politely.

ch.t: Change a price, then change it back
ch.do: Me → ⚙️ Admin → Price list → Home 5 Mbps → change 1500 to 1700 → Save package. Open John Kamau's customer page. Then set Home 5 Mbps back to 1500 → Save package.
ch.end: While it was 1700, John Kamau still paid 1500 (old customers keep their price). It is back to 1500 now.

ch.do: 📊 Report → Export October to CSV. Open the file on the phone.
ch.end: A CSV with every expense (with VAT and PIN columns), money in, payments and counts.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: Weak WiFi in the staff room
ch.do: Isaac of Satellite Academy phones you: “The WiFi in the staff room is weak. Can you pass today?” You go. The staff room is far from the router; you change the WiFi channel and it is a little better, but they really need a second access point. There was no job for this. What do you do in Zuri?
ch.hint: Jobs → ＋ Log a job: Fault / no internet, “Satellite Academy (Isaac 0700 000 204): weak WiFi in the staff room” → Save job. What did you find? type “Staff room far from the router”. What did you do? Fixed settings + Tested — working → ✅ Job finished. Tasks → ＋ Add a task: “Satellite Academy needs a 2nd access point for the staff room — offer it (price?)” → Who should do it? Partners → Add task.
ch.end: A Done job for the school visit, and the Partners have a task to sell an access point.

ch.t: Try to approve your own payment
ch.do: Money → ✍️ Record → Money out: Town Centre, Paid to “Partner test”, 100, Other, M-Pesa. Save. Then go to 👥 Approvals and try to approve it yourself. Then ↩ Withdraw it.
ch.end: Zuri does NOT let you approve your own payment (no Approve button / “a second person must approve it”). After Withdraw it is gone.

ch.t: Customers who ran out — read Who paid

Tasks → ＋ Add a task: “Stephen Mutua says he paid 3,000 cash (500 ‘transport’); the job shows 2,500 — please check” → Who should do it? Partners → Add task.

ch.end: They told you the install is 2,500 and there is no transport fee, said the office will check and call back — and did not shout about the technician.

days.title: Grow: a new area
days.story: People in Suswa are asking for internet. Finance plans the new area in 📈 Projects; the Partner checks it. Everyone does a receipts audit: every shilling spent this week has a receipt.

ch.do: Purity's job. Found: Bad connector. Did: Replaced connector + Tested — working. ✅ Job finished.

ch.do: 📈 Projects → ＋ New project. Name: Suswa town. Area: Suswa (planned). Create. A · Start-up: Fiber cable to lay 6 km · Fiber cost per km 290000 · OLT & core equipment 600000 · Labour 400000. C · Customers: Homes passed 900 · Sign-ups month 1: 10 · month 3: 35 · month 6: 70 · month 12: 120 · month 24: 200 · Install fee 2500 · Leave each month 2 · Use it next to “From …” for the monthly bill.
ch.end: The green line shows a start-up cost (about KES 3M) and a payback month. Write both in your note.

ch.do: Pull down to refresh first (the Partner just added Suswa). The voice calls three times as people from Suswa. For each: ＋ New customer, Area Suswa (planned), Status Lead, the name, phone and landmark they give, notes “Suswa interest — waiting for the Suswa plan”. No job.

days.title: Close the week
days.story: Practise a month-end: the last count, next month's bills, the late payers, the Suswa decision, a staff member leaving, and print everything. Then tell us the truth: best, worst, what to fix first.

ch.do: Count the cash: Town Centre Bank 73500, M-Pesa 48000. Satellite Bank 57500, M-Pesa 16000.
ch.end: Two counts. Money → 💵 Today shows cash after bills for each area.

ch.do: My jobs → Done. Count installs and faults.
ch.end: Write the numbers in your note.

ch.do: After the Partner moves them: My jobs shows Tech 3's open Satellite jobs. Open each; read it.
ch.end: The moved jobs are in your list.

ch.do: Every open job: add a note for Tech 2 (what is left to do). Then tell the Partner “ready”.
ch.end: Every open job has a hand-over note.

ch.do: Money → 📋 Bills → → (next month) → Copy last month's bills (for each area).
ch.end: November has the same six bills, unpaid.

ch.do: 📈 Projects → Suswa town (waiting for your OK). Read it once more. ✅ Approve — lock the plan (or decline with a reason).
ch.end: “📊 Actual vs plan” and “🚀 Approved — starts …”. The plan is now the yardstick.

ch.do: Faith calls: please move her connection to shop 22. Find her → ＋ New job: Move connection, “Move from shop 14 to shop 22”, Tech 2, tomorrow.
ch.end: A Move connection job for Tech 2.

ch.do: Phone Call center 1 as Faith: “I'm moving the salon to shop 22 next week. Can you move my internet?”
ch.end: A Move connection job and a day.

ch.do: Money → 👥 Customers → Who paid → Late.
ch.end: Write the late customers in your note. They should match Call center's follow-ups.

ch.do: First move the jobs: Jobs → All techs → pick Tech 3 → open each open job → Send to tech: Tech 2 → Save. Then Admin → People → Tech 3 → untick On → Save.
ch.end: Tech 3 is switched off. No open job is left with Tech 3.

ch.do: Tech 3 is “leaving” (pretend). Staff & pay → Tech 3 → untick “Working for Zuri now” → Save.
ch.end: Tech 3 shows as not working now; next pay run won't include them.

ch.do: The school asks for 50 Mbps. Not on the price list yet → Tasks → ＋ Add a task for Partners: “Satellite Academy wants 50 Mbps — price?” After the Partner adds it, edit the school: Package Business 50 Mbps, Monthly rate 7000.
ch.end: The school's package is Business 50 Mbps, 7,000.

ch.do: Turn on airplane mode. Open any Done job and add a note “Offline test”. Turn airplane mode off and wait.
ch.end: With no signal: “⏳ not sent”. With signal back: it sends by itself.

ch.do: Phone Call center 2 as Isaac of Satellite Academy: “Do you have 50 Mbps? How much?”
ch.end: They found out and told you 7,000 (after the Partner added it).

ch.do: Close Zuri and open it again.
ch.end: Zuri says your account is switched off / “Almost there”. Write in your note what you saw — was it clear?

ch.do: Satellite Academy asked for 50 Mbps. Admin → 💲 Price list: add “Business 50 Mbps” 7000.
ch.end: Five packages in the price list.

ch.do: Save as PDF on your phone: 📊 Report → 🖨 Printable view. 📈 Projects → Suswa town → 🖨 One-page report. And Export October to CSV.
ch.end: Three files on your phone: report PDF, Suswa PDF, October CSV. Send them to the team group.

ch.do: Customers: set the status box to Any status, then search each Town Centre customer. Fix any double, missing phone or wrong package.
ch.end: No doubles. Every customer has a phone and package. Note what you fixed.

ch.do: Read the Move connection job for tomorrow.
ch.end: It's there with the new shop in the summary.

ch.do: Testers' List “Tell us” box: For each call this week, were they polite? Fast? Right? Give the team a mark out of 10, and the one call that went worst.
ch.end: Your report card is sent.

ch.t: Run the manager and read it
ch.do: Tasks → 🤖 Run the manager now → Manager log.
ch.end: The run line. Write the 2 most useful things it says.

ch.do: Customers: set the status box to Any status, pick Satellite in the area picker, and look at the status on each customer.
ch.end: Only the Suswa leads (and anyone not yet installed) are Leads. Note anyone wrong.

ch.do: Bills → next month → Staff transport → ✏️ change the due day to 25 → Save. Then add a bill “TEST bill” 100 → open it → 🗑️ Remove this bill.
ch.end: Staff transport is due on the 25th. TEST bill is gone.

ch.do: Testers' List → Business Week → the “Tell us” box: 1 best thing, 1 worst thing, 1 thing to fix first.
ch.end: Your three lines are sent.

ch.end: Every tester shows up in the activity. Customers and cash in the Areas table match the report. Note anything that does not match.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: A customer calls your own phone
ch.do: You have left Zuri. In the evening Beatrice Wambui calls your own phone: “My internet goes off in the afternoon. Please come — I'll pay you 1,000 cash directly, it's quicker!” What do you do?
ch.hint: You are switched off, so Zuri won't let you work (open it once — what does it say?). Don't do private work on Zuri's network and don't take the cash. Tell Beatrice to call the Zuri office. Post in the team group for Call center 2: “Beatrice Wambui (0700 000 205): off every afternoon — please make a job.”
ch.end: Beatrice was sent to the office, Call center 2 got the details in the group, and you took no money. In your note: what did Zuri show you?

ch.do: Testers' List → Business Week → “Tell us” box: Would you run the real Zuri Fiber on this system on Monday? Yes / not yet — and why.
ch.end: Your answer is sent.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: Samuel can't pay — can he go smaller?
ch.do: Samuel Otieno finally answers: “Sorry, I lost my job. I paid only 700. I can pay the rest on Friday the 30th. And from next month please give me the cheaper internet.” What do you do in Zuri?
ch.hint: 1) His payment follow-up: Jobs → 📩 Today's texts, or Jobs → Samuel's Payment follow-up → 🤝 Will pay → Or pick a day: 30 Oct → Save. 2) The package: Customers → Samuel Otieno → ✏️ Edit → Notes: “From 1 Nov wants Home 5 Mbps (1,500) — change on the billing website too” → Save customer (keep 10 Mbps / 2,000 until then). 3) Tasks → ＋ Add a task for Finance: “Samuel Otieno: Home 5 Mbps from November on the billing website” → Add task. Tell him: 1,300 left for October; 1,500 a month from November.
ch.end: Samuel's follow-up says he promised to pay by 30 Oct, his page has a note about the smaller package from November, and Finance has a task.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: A Satellite fault on your phone
ch.do: Mercy Atieno (Satellite) sends you a WhatsApp: “Red light since morning!” Tech 3 has left, so you go. You find a bad connector, replace it, and it works. Mercy is not in your area. How do you put this in Zuri?
ch.hint: Best: ask Call center 2 to make a fault job for Mercy and send it to you, then fill it in. If that is not possible: Jobs → ＋ Log a job: Fault / no internet, “Mercy Atieno (Satellite, 0700 000 201): red light — fixed” → Save job. What did you find? Bad connector. What did you do? Replaced connector + Tested — working. Parts: Fast connector, Qty 1 → Add → ✅ Job finished. Tasks → ＋ Add a task for Call center: “I fixed Mercy's red light — please link my job to her / check the area”. (Could you choose Satellite as the area? Tell us.)
ch.end: A Done job with what you found and did, and the office knows it was Mercy in Satellite.

ch.t: 🎭 Problem call: Samuel lost his job (to Call center 1)
ch.do: Phone Call center 1 as Samuel Otieno — the man who never answered. Sound tired.
ch.where: Phone call (or WhatsApp) to Call center 1
say: Samuel Otieno, 0700 000 108. Sorry I didn't answer before.
I lost my job. I paid only 700.
I can pay the rest on Friday the 30th.
And from next month, please give me the cheaper internet. How much is it?
ch.check: They wrote down your promise for the 30th, told you how much is left (1,300) and the cheaper price (1,500 a month) — and did not change your package today without asking.
ch.end: They wrote down your promise for the 30th, told you how much is left (1,300) and the cheaper price (1,500 a month) — and did not change your package today without asking.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: Tech 3 sends back the float
ch.do: Tech 3 left today. He still had 1,700 of Zuri's money on his M-Pesa. He sends it back to the Zuri M-Pesa: code UKT3BACK17. But one of his receipts this week is still missing. What do you put in Zuri — and what about the missing receipt?
ch.hint: Money → ✍️ Record → Money in: Area Satellite, What for Other, 1700, Received into M-Pesa, From “Tech 3 — float returned”, Ref UKT3BACK17 → Save cash in. Then 📊 Report → 🧾 Receipts this week → Missing: find Tech 3's line. He can't snap it now (switched off). Tasks → ＋ Add a task: “Tech 3 left; receipt missing for … (amount) — accept it or take it from his last pay?” → Who should do it? Partners → Add task.
ch.end: Money in shows 1,700 from Tech 3 (UKT3BACK17), and the Partners have a task about his missing receipt, with the amount.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: “I already paid your colleague”
ch.do: Joyce Wangari (Satellite) phones you: “Tech 3 came on Wednesday and took 1,000 cash to book my install. So on Monday I pay you only 1,500, OK?” Tech 3 has left. What do you do?
ch.hint: Don't argue, and don't agree about the money alone. Jobs → My jobs → Joyce Wangari's install (moved to you from Tech 3) → read the Notes: any 1,000? Notes: “Customer says she paid Tech 3 1,000 cash on Wednesday — not in Zuri” → Add. Tasks → ＋ Add a task: “Joyce Wangari says she paid Tech 3 1,000 — check before Monday's install” → Who should do it? Partners → Add task. (No job for Joyce in your list? Then the task for the Partners only.) Tell Joyce the office confirms before Monday.
ch.end: Joyce's job (if you have it) has your note, the Partners have a task, and you did not promise a lower price.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: A 6-month deal for the hotel
ch.do: Daniel of the hotel calls you: “Give me Business 50 Mbps for 6,000 a month instead of 7,000, and I pay 6 months now — 36,000.” Is it a good deal for Zuri? Decide. If yes, make sure Zuri shows the deal, and that Finance knows how the 36,000 comes in. What do you do?
ch.hint: Think: 6 × 1,000 = 6,000 less, but 36,000 cash now. Optional: Money → 👥 Customers → Next 30 days → One-off +36000 tomorrow to see the effect (remove it after). If YES: Customers → Daniel Kiprono (Longonot View Hotel) → ✏️ Edit → Package Business 50 Mbps, Monthly rate 6000, Notes “6-month deal from 1 Nov, 36,000 paid up front — Partner” → Save customer. Tasks → ＋ Add a task for Finance: “Hotel pays 36,000 for 6 months to the paybill — check it on the billing website, expiry 1 May” → Add task. If NO: a note on the hotel with your reason.
ch.end: The hotel's page shows the package, the rate and a note with the deal (or your reason for no), and Finance has a task. The price list still says 7,000.

ch.t: 🧠 Real-world problem: Beatrice goes off every afternoon
ch.do: Beatrice Wambui calls: “Since Wednesday my internet goes off every afternoon, from 2 to 4.” Tech 3 left this morning. Who goes to Satellite now? What do you do?
ch.hint: Look for a red 📡 outage box first (one customer = not an outage). Customers → Beatrice → ＋ New job: Fault / no internet, “Off every afternoon 2–4 pm since Wednesday”, Send to tech: Tech 2 (he took Satellite), Visit day Monday → Save job. If Tech 2 is NOT in the list (he is a Town Centre tech): leave “Not yet — decide later”, save, and Tasks → ＋ Add a task: “Tech 2 can't be picked for Satellite jobs — please fix his area (Admin → People)” → Who should do it? Partners. Tell Beatrice the day.
ch.end: Beatrice has a fault job — with Tech 2, or with no tech plus a task for the Partners saying why. She got a day.

ch.t: 🎭 Problem call: Beatrice: off every afternoon (to Call center 2)
ch.do: Phone Call center 2 as Beatrice Wambui.
ch.where: Phone call (or WhatsApp) to Call center 2
say: Beatrice Wambui, 0700 000 205, off the Suswa road, mabati house.
Since Wednesday my internet goes off every afternoon, from 2 to 4.
Who is coming? I heard your Satellite technician left!
ch.check: They made a job, gave you a day, and told you who is coming (the technician now covering Satellite) — or honestly said the office will confirm today.
ch.end: They made a job, gave you a day, and told you who is coming (the technician now covering Satellite) — or honestly said the office will confirm today.
